summary: Frontend-only testing of the new AlertsCenterModal (Centro de Alertas). Verified opening from the bell dropdown CTA, loading of 200 notifications, filters (tab/priority/search), individual mark-as-read with counter update, mark-all-read with badge sync, and open-link navigation with modal close. All requested flows work.

issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby on shadcn DialogContent — console warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Minor accessibility fix.

With 200 unread notifications, the bell's numeric badge did not render (no [data-testid=notification-badge] present) even though the Centro de Alertas showed '200 sin leer'. Possibly a cap/threshold or badge selector mismatch — not caused by the new feature (refresh() is called and works after mark-all → badge goes to cleared correctly), but the user-visible signal on the sidebar bell is missing for very-high unread counts. Worth checking NotificationBell badge rendering.
React hydration errors: <span> as child of <tbody> and <tr> inside <span> in Dashboard commitments table (unrelated to this feature).

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to AlertsCenterModal DialogContent for a11y.
(Unrelated to this feature) Investigate why NotificationBell badge is not shown when there are hundreds of unread notifications on the sidebar.
(Unrelated) Fix Dashboard hydration warnings (span inside tbody / tr wrapped in span).
critical_code_review_comments: AlertsCenterModal.jsx is well structured (<250 lines), uses proper data-testid throughout, useMemo/useCallback appropriately.
Filters combine correctly (AND semantics between tab, priority and search — verified: 200 all -> 200 unread -> 129 unread+high).
goToItem correctly awaits markOne before navigate/close.
Consider adding DialogDescription for shadcn a11y requirement.
Consider empty-string fallback for n.priority defaulting to 'medium' both in filter and label (already handled in label, consistent).
seed_data_creation: None. Executed POST /notifications/mark-all-read on admin user in preview (expected/acceptable per task note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature Centro de Alertas is fully working. Verified: modal opens centered from `notification-open-center`, loads 200 alerts, footer counter updates with filters (200/200 all, 200/200 unread, 129/200 unread+high, 152/200 search 'z'), `alert-markread-{id}` marks one and decrements `alerts-center-unread` (200→199) and removes the markread control from that row, `alert-open-{id}` navigates to /quotes and closes modal, `alerts-mark-all-btn` clears all unread and updates bell (no residual badge). Only observation: with all 200 alerts unread the sidebar bell numeric badge did not render — likely pre-existing, worth a look but does not block this feature.
